content.what_it_is: Preprocessor-guarded Fortran module MOD_FOAM (L1-L561) holding foam state, configuration, and work arrays. It allocates and initializes foam fields (L39-L254), reads optional foam controls with defaults and logging (L56-L227), advances a foam-thickness balance with source, exponential sink, and flux divergence (L256-L311), imposes physical-edge values and exchanges the scalar field (L360-L405), supplies reconstructed ICCE and first-order upwind flux-divergence alternatives (L407-L511), and grows/dries a binary foam mask by neighboring thickness differences (L513-L557).
entities: module scalars PLOT_INTV_FOAM and PLOT_COUNT_FOAM at L11
module scalars BurstRate at L12, MinThick at L15, TransferRate at L16, CdFoam at L17, f_source at L29, and FoamTimeScale at L30
allocatable foam state arrays EtaFoam, EtaFoamMax, UFoam, VFoam at L19
allocatable surface/depth arrays Usurf1, Vsurf1, VFsurf1, Usurf2, Vsurf2, VFsurf2, Usurf, Vsurf, VFsurf, DepthFoam at L20-L23
allocatable flux/reconstruction arrays MxFoam, MyFoam, FxFoam, FyFoam, GxFoam, GyFoam at L26-L27
allocatable SinkM and SourceM at L28
local reconstruction arrays VxL, VxR, VyL, VyR, DelX, DelY at L409-L411

unresolved: Name/interface conflict: MOD_FOAM defines host entity SMALL at L35, while contained INITIALIZATION_FOAM independently USE-associates GLOBAL::SMALL at L58. Unless these resolve to the same entity through nonstandard compiler behavior, the contained scope has two distinct accessible entities named SMALL and can fail compilation or bind ambiguously; the imported SMALL is not used in the routine.

PARALLEL branches reference myid repeatedly beginning at L79, but neither the module's PARALLEL USE GLOBAL ONLY list at L8 nor the contained routine's list at L60 imports myid. The only possible source is unrestricted USE INPUT_READ at L63, making compilation depend on unintended re-export of myid by that module.

FOAM_FLUX chooses one branch from the sign of the west x-face u(I,J) at L477, then uses that same branch to form both west and east contributions at L479-L487; the east face u(I+1,J) is never independently sign-tested. The analogous y calculation tests only v(I,J) at L495 while combining v(I,J) and v(I,J+1) at L497-L505. Converging/diverging cells with opposite face signs therefore use the wrong donor on one face.
